recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-11465 unless the Conformance roadmap is separately rewritten for substantive reasons.
issue_request: FHIR-11465 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Conformance module roadmap, raised and applied for DSTU2. It asked to change 'Over the past two years, these resources are mainly used' to 'Over the past two years, these resources have been mainly used' and was auto-approved as a non-substantive grammar issue.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn @10141. Git commit d3c64ad7c6df6bb51d8fbba3e4a173f2a4c2398e, dated 2016-11-08 and explicitly listing #11465, changed source/conformance-module.html from the existing wording to the proposed wording.
additional_context: The current Conformance module page is still in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml, but the 2016 sentence no longer exists in current source. Later roadmap edits, including 72187f66d0a50b52204690177ad8c04e40b2a598 and 0b361f316d, removed the date-bound lead-in and then removed the remaining 'These resources have been mainly used' sentence before the current maintenance-mode rewrite.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because current build-scope source does not contain either the incorrect sentence or any semantically equivalent grammatical defect.
